arxiv-2206-14403.title: On the Fourth-Order Lattice Gel’fand–Dikii Equations
arxiv-2206-14403.creator: Guesh Yfter TELA a, Song-Lin ZHAO b and Da-Jun ZHANG a
arxiv-2206-14403.description: Abstract The fourth-order lattice Gel’fand–Dikii equations in quadrilateral form are investigated. Utilizing the direct linearization approach, we present some equations of the extended lattice Gel’fand–Dikii type. These equations are related to a quartic discrete dispersion relation and can be viewed as higher-order members of the extended lattice Boussinesq type equations.

arxiv-2207-00713.title: q-Learning in Continuous Time
arxiv-2207-00713.creator: Yanwei Jia yanweijia@cuhk.edu.hk, Xun Yu Zhou xz2574@columbia.edu
arxiv-2207-00713.description: Abstract We study the continuous-time counterpart of Q-learning for reinforcement learning (RL) under the entropy-regularized, exploratory diffusion process formulation introduced by Wang et al. 2020 . As the conventional (big) Q-function collapses in continuous time, we consider its first-order approximation and coin the term “(little) q-function”.

arxiv-2207-08829.title: Landau-Forbidden Quantum Criticality in Rydberg Quantum Simulators
arxiv-2207-08829.creator: Jong Yeon Lee, Joshua Ramette, Max A. Metlitski, Vladan Vuletic, Wen Wei Ho, Soonwon Choi
arxiv-2207-08829.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jong Yeon Lee, Joshua Ramette, Max A. Metlitski, Vladan Vuletic, Wen Wei Ho, Soonwon Choi. The Landau-Ginzburg-Wilson theory of phase transitions precludes a continuous transition between two phases that spontaneously break distinct symmetries. However, quantum mechanical effects can intertwine the symmetries, giving rise to an exotic phenomenon called deconfined quantum criticality (DQC).

arxiv-2208-01335.title: Entangled X-ray Photon Pair Generation by Free Electron Lasers
arxiv-2208-01335.creator: Linfeng Zhang, Zunqi Li, Dongyu Liu, Chengyin Wu, Haitan Xu, Zheng Li
arxiv-2208-01335.description: Abstract 2022 † † equal-contributors: These authors contributed equally to this work. † † equal-contributors: These authors contributed equally to this work. Einstein, Podolsky and Rosen’s prediction einstein1935can on incompleteness of quantum mechanics was overturned by experimental tests on Bell’s inequality bell1966problem that confirmed the existence of quantum entanglement.

arxiv-2208-09487.title: 30 to 100-kG magnetic fields in the cores of red giant stars
arxiv-2208-09487.creator: Gang Li (李刚), Sébastien Deheuvels, Jérôme Ballot, François Lignières
arxiv-2208-09487.description: Abstract A red giant star is an evolved low- or intermediate-mass star that has exhausted its central hydrogen content, leaving a helium core and a hydrogen-burning shell. Oscillations of stars can be observed as periodic dimmings and brightenings in the optical light curves.

arxiv-2212-08571.title: Statistical Design and Analysis for Robust Machine Learning: A Case Study from COVID-19
arxiv-2212-08571.creator: Davide Pigoli, Kieran Baker ∗, Jobie Budd, Lorraine Butler, Harry Coppock, Sabrina Egglestone, Steven G. Gilmour, Chris Holmes, David Hurley, Radka Jersakova, Ivan Kiskin, Vasiliki Koutra, Jonathon Mellor, George Nicholson, Joe Packham, Selina Patel, Richard Payne, Stephen J. Roberts, Björn W. Schul
arxiv-2212-08571.description: Abstract Since early in the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, there has been interest in using artificial intelligence methods to predict COVID-19 infection status based on vocal audio signals, for example cough recordings. However, existing studies have limitations in terms of data collection and of the assessment of the performances of the proposed predictive models.

arxiv-2309-07276.title: Language-Conditioned Observation Models for Visual Object Search
arxiv-2309-07276.creator: Thao Nguyen, Vladislav Hrosinkov, Eric Rosen, Stefanie Tellex
arxiv-2309-07276.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Thao Nguyen, Vladislav Hrosinkov, Eric Rosen, Stefanie Tellex. Object search is a challenging task because when given complex language descriptions ( e.g., “find the white cup on the table”), the robot must move its camera through the environment and recognize the described object. Previous works map language descriptions to a set of fixed object detectors with predetermined noise models, but these approaches are challenging to scale because new detectors need to be made for each object.

arxiv-2311-12156.title: Between Ramsey and measurable cardinals Thanks: We are grateful to Philip Welch for his kind permission to use an argument of his in the proof of Lemma 3.14 . Thanks: This research was funded in whole or in part by EPSRC grant number EP/V009001/1 of the second-listed author. For the purpose of open
arxiv-2311-12156.creator: Victoria Gitman, Philipp Schlicht
arxiv-2311-12156.description: Abstract . We study several intertwined hierarchies between κ \kappa -Ramsey cardinals and measurable cardinals to illuminate the structure of the large cardinal hierarchy in this region. In particular, we study baby versions of measurability introduced by Bovykin and McKenzie and some variants by locating these notions in the large cardinal hierarchy and providing characterisations via filter games.

arxiv-2311-15030.title: A Learning Quasi-stiffness Control Framework of a Powered Transfemoral Prosthesis for Adaptive Speed and Incline Walking
arxiv-2311-15030.creator: Teng Ma, Shucong Yin, Zhimin Hou, Yuxuan Wang, Binxin Huang, Haoyong Yu, Chenglong Fu
arxiv-2311-15030.description: Abstract Impedance-based control represents a prevalent strategy in the powered transfemoral prostheses because of its ability to reproduce natural walking. However, most existing studies have developed impedance-based prosthesis controllers for specific tasks, while creating a task-adaptive controller for variable-task walking continues to be a significant challenge.

arxiv-2402-07092.title: Generalizing Conversational Dense Retrieval via LLM-Cognition Data Augmentation
arxiv-2402-07092.creator: Haonan Chen, Zhicheng Dou, Kelong Mao, Jiongnan Liu, Ziliang Zhao
arxiv-2402-07092.description: Abstract Conversational search utilizes muli-turn natural language contexts to retrieve relevant passages. Existing conversational dense retrieval models mostly view a conversation as a fixed sequence of questions and responses, overlooking the severe data sparsity problem – that is, users can perform a conversation in various ways. Consequently, they often struggle to generalize to diverse conversations in real-world scenarios.

arxiv-2404-00679.title: Weak-to-Strong 3D Object Detection with X-Ray Distillation
arxiv-2404-00679.creator: Alexander Gambashidze, Aleksandr Dadukin, Maxim Golyadkin, Maria Razzhivina, Ilya Makarov
arxiv-2404-00679.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Alexander Gambashidze, Aleksandr Dadukin, Maxim Golyadkin, Maria Razzhivina, Ilya Makarov. This paper addresses the critical challenges of sparsity and occlusion in LiDAR-based 3D object detection. Current methods often rely on supplementary modules or specific architectural designs, potentially limiting their applicability to new and evolving architectures. To our knowledge, we are the first to propose a versatile technique that seamlessly integrates into any existing framework for 3D Object Detection, marking the first instance of Weak-to-Strong generalization in 3D computer vision.

arxiv-2404-16698.title: Cooperate or Collapse: Emergence of Sustainable Cooperation in a Society of LLM Agents
arxiv-2404-16698.creator: Giorgio Piatti, Zhijing Jin, Max Kleiman-Weiner, Bernhard Schölkopf Mrinmaya Sachan Rada Mihalcea
arxiv-2404-16698.description: Abstract As AI systems pervade human life, ensuring that large language models (LLMs) make safe decisions remains a significant challenge. We introduce the Gov ernance of the Commons Sim ulation ( GovSim ), a generative simulation platform designed to study strategic interactions and cooperative decision-making in LLMs.

arxiv-2508-02548.title: The KG-ER Conceptual Schema Language
arxiv-2508-02548.creator: Enrico Franconi, Benoît Groz, Jan Hidders, Nina Pardal, Sławek Staworko, Jan Van den Bussche, Piotr Wieczorek
arxiv-2508-02548.description: Abstract We propose KG-ER , a conceptual schema language for knowledge graphs that describes the structure of knowledge graphs independently of their representation (relational databases, property graphs, RDF) while helping to capture the semantics of the information stored in a knowledge graph.

arxiv-2509-05359.title: An Empirical Analysis of Discrete Unit Representations in Speech Language Modeling Pre-training
arxiv-2509-05359.creator: Yanis Labrak, Richard Dufour, Mickaël Rouvier
arxiv-2509-05359.description: Abstract This paper investigates discrete unit representations in Speech Language Models (SLMs), focusing on optimizing speech modeling during continual pre-training. In this paper, we systematically examine how model architecture, data representation, and training robustness influence the pre-training stage in which we adapt existing pre-trained language models to the speech modality.

arxiv-2510-17725.title: AcademicEval: Live Long-Context LLM Benchmark
arxiv-2510-17725.creator: Haozhen Zhang haozhenz@illinois.edu, wazhz14@gmail.com, Tao Feng taofeng2@illinois.edu, Pengrui Han phan12@illinois.edu, Jiaxuan You jiaxuan@illinois.edu
arxiv-2510-17725.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently achieved remarkable performance in long-context understanding. However, current long-context LLM benchmarks are limited by rigid context length, labor-intensive annotation, and the pressing challenge of label leakage issues during LLM training. Therefore, we propose AcademicEval , a live benchmark for evaluating LLMs over long-context generation tasks.

arxiv-2512-21115.title: Discrete-time asset price bubbles with short sales prohibitions under model uncertainty
arxiv-2512-21115.creator: Wenqing Zhang
arxiv-2512-21115.description: Abstract In this study, we investigate asset price bubbles in a discrete-time, discrete-state market under model uncertainty and short sales prohibitions. Building on a new fundamental theorem of asset pricing and a superhedging duality in this setting, we introduce a notion of bubble based on a novel definition of the fundamental price, and analyze their types and characterization.

arxiv-2601-10404.title: Spectroscopic follow-up of Gaia alerted YSO variables: the LBT view Thanks: Based on observations made with the Large Binocular Telescope operated by the Fundación Galileo Galilei (FGG) of the Istituto Nazionale di Astrofisica (INAF) at the Observatorio del Roque de los Muchachos (La Palma, Canary I
arxiv-2601-10404.creator: Teresa Giannini, Manuele Gangi, Fernando Cruz-Sáenz de Miera, Brunella Nisini, Máté Szilágyi, Katia Biazzo, Ágnes Kóspál, Péter Ábrahám, Simone Antoniucci, Roberta Carini, Eleonora Fiorellino, Adriana Gargiulo, Ester Marini, Zsófia Nagy, Maria Gabriela Navarro, Fabrizio Vitali
arxiv-2601-10404.description: Abstract We analyzed optical/near-IR Large Binocular Telescope spectra of 16 sources alerted by Gaia between 2021 and 2024 due to significant photometric variability. Half of the spectra were taken during quiescence and the rest during a burst or at intermediate brightness.

pmc-10532871.title: Investigation of Spark Plasma Sintering on Microstructure-Properties of Zirconia Reinforced Fluormica Glass for Dental Restorations
pmc-10532871.creator: Sivaranjani Gali, Suhasini Gururaja, T. Niranjana Prabhu, Srikari Srinivasan
pmc-10532871.description: Background: Conventional sintering methods of dental ceramics have limitations of high temperature and slow cooling rates with requirements of additional heat treatment for crystallization. Spark plasma sintering (SPS) is an emerging technique that has the potential to process dental restorations with dense microstructures and tailor-made clinically relevant properties with optimized processing parameters.

pmc-10652304.title: Senolytic treatment reduces oxidative protein stress in an aging male murine model of post‐traumatic osteoarthritis
pmc-10652304.creator: Alexander F. Chin, Jin Han, Cristina C. Clement, Younghwan Choi, Hong Zhang, Maria Browne, Ok Hee Jeon, Jennifer H. Elisseeff
pmc-10652304.description: Senolytic drugs are designed to selectively clear senescent cells (SnCs) that accumulate with injury or aging. In a mouse model of osteoarthritis (OA), senolysis yields a pro‐regenerative response, but the therapeutic benefit is reduced in aged mice. Increased oxidative stress is a hallmark of advanced age.

pmc-11504794.title: Improving access to utilize the healthcare services facilitated by ASHAs, ANMs and medical officers of PHC among scheduled tribe pregnant women: An interventional study
pmc-11504794.creator: Anju Damu Ade, Visweswara Rao Guthi, Nagaraj Kondagunta, D. S. Sujith Kumar, Ravisankar Deekala, Chandrasekhar Vallepalli, T V D Prathyusha
pmc-11504794.description: Introduction:Early marriages, early childbirth, low BMI and high incidence of anaemia are known factors for high maternal mortality among tribal pregnant women.Materials and Methods:This was a mixed method study (qualitative and quantitative) undertaken to evaluate educational intervention package among tribal pregnant women in Chittoor District of Andhra Pradesh State in South India.

pmc-11643101.title: Fish: a new xenograft source for maxillary sinus lifting*
pmc-11643101.creator: Emrah Soylu, Musab Süleyman Kilavuz, Fatih Duman, Hasan Ekeer, Zeynep Burçin Gönen, Beyza Kahraman, Arzu Hanım Yay, Demet Bolat
pmc-11643101.description: Objective:Although autogenous grafting is accepted as the gold standard in intraoral grafting, xenogenous grafts are frequently used in sinus lift surgeries due to their osteoinductive and osteoconductive properties. This study aimed to investigate the efficacy of fish spine-derived xenogenic grafts in sinus augmentation surgery.

pmc-12573038.title: Acid-Oxygen Synergistic Technology for Targeted Dissolution of Hybrid Organic–Inorganic Blockages in Low-Permeability Reservoirs
pmc-12573038.creator: Chunmin Qi, Yu Xia, Shanfa Tang, Lianji Zhao
pmc-12573038.description: Low-permeability reservoirs are plagued by persistent hybrid organic–inorganic blockages in associated water injection wells (or pipelines), particularly under harsh environmental conditions. In northern Shaanxi, China, water injection wells exhibit chronic high-pressure under-injection (>10 MPa), a critical issue linked to unresolved scaling and organic residue accumulation. Conventional chemical treatments fail in subzero winters due to reagent freezing and inefficient dual-phase targeting.

pmc-12746168.title: Investigation of Serum Calcium and Vitamin D Levels in Patients with Refractory Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo
pmc-12746168.creator: Asuman Feda Bayrak, Baturalp Çetin, Mehmet Doğan
pmc-12746168.description: ObjectiveIt is not known exactly what causes recurrence in benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV) patients. We aimed to investigate the relationship between the number of maneuvers and serum vitamin D and calcium levels in BPPV cases treated with appropriate maneuvers after correct diagnosis.MethodsA total of 86 BPPV patients, 68 (79.9%) female and 18 (20.1%) male were included in the study.

pmc-12954280.creator: Preeti Lamba
pmc-12954280.description: a forensic autopsy study in a tropical setting” (Forensic Sci Int Synergy. 2026; 12:100659) [1]. pmc-13380141.title: The efficacy of colorectal cancer screening: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13380141.creator: Sai Nyan Lin Tun, Noppcha Singweratham, Pallop Siewchaisakul, Napaphat Poprom
pmc-13380141.description: ObjectiveTo estimate sensitivity and specificity for two major colorectal cancer screening tests in asymptomatic average-risk adults: fecal immunochemical testing and colonoscopy.MethodsThis review was registered in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (CRD420250635078) on 7 January 2025 and conducted according to Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines.

pmc-13388570.title: Association of Diaphragmatic Crus Thickness Assessed by Computed Tomography with Diaphragmatic Excursion and Exercise Capacity in Patients with Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
pmc-13388570.creator: Masashi Shiraishi, Yuji Higashimoto, Hiroki Mizusawa, Yu Takeda, Masaya Noguchi, Kengo Kanki, Honoka Natsume, Osamu Nishiyama, Ryo Yamazaki, Tamotsu Kimura, Hisako Matsumoto
pmc-13388570.description: PurposeDiaphragmatic dysfunction contributes to exercise intolerance in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Although diaphragmatic excursion during deep breathing (DEmax) is associated with exercise capacity, the relationship between computed tomography (CT)-derived diaphragm morphology and diaphragmatic function remains unclear. We investigated the association of CT-derived diaphragmatic crus thickness with diaphragmatic excursion and exercise capacity in COPD.

pmc-13580059.title: High-resolution analog-to-digital converter-based data acquisition system for geoelectrical prospecting
pmc-13580059.creator: Miguel López Jiménez, Alfredo Ghisays Ruiz, Paola Pacheco Martínez, Juan Álvarez Navarro
pmc-13580059.description: Electrical resistivity surveying is a fundamental geophysical technique for subsurface characterization, based on the measurement of apparent resistivity using the four-point method. The reliable acquisition of these data requires high-resolution and stable instrumentation, capable of detecting small variations in electrical signals.

pmc-13634273.title: Systematic optimization of Komagataella phaffii (Pichia pastoris) for high-efficiency recombinant protein production: Advancements in strain engineering, fermentation optimization, and AI-driven technologies
pmc-13634273.creator: Yue Huang, Jialiang Wang, Aoxue Wang, Liqi Zheng, Ying Lin, Shuli Liang
pmc-13634273.description: Komagataella phaffii (formerly Pichia pastoris) has emerged as an indispensable eukaryotic expression host for the production of industrial enzymes, food proteins, and therapeutic proteins owing to its Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) status, efficient protein secretion capacity, eukaryotic post-translational modification system, and high cell-density fermentation capabilities.

uslaw-usc-t16-s4004.title: 16 U.S.C. § 4004 — Establishment of National Council
uslaw-usc-t16-s4004.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s4004.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 60 (Fish And Seafood Promotion). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment There is established the National Fish and Seafood Promotional Council. (b) Composition (1) The National Council shall be composed of the Secretary, who shall be a nonvoting member, and fifteen voting members appointed by the Secretary. (2) Nominations for appointees shall be submitted.
